developerMode.preferenceDescription: Show the code editor on this laptop. Off by default: files open in the laptop's own apps and SimpleTab's pages are used for everything else.
developerMode.editorHidden: This needs the code editor, which is only available in developer mode. Turn it on with "SimpleTab: Toggle developer mode" in the command palette.
developerMode.tournamentFileNotOpened: {name} belongs to the open tournament and only SimpleTab itself reads and changes it. Use SimpleTab's pages to see and change the tournament.
